nodes.label: Contract: AI agents API — MCP, REST, OAuth (v1)
AgentService shared service layer (MCP thin adapter)
nodes.rationale: MCP layer is a thin adapter; REST calls the same functions (R-13) to avoid divergence

nodes.label: /mcp MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless)
nodes.rationale: Stateless handler: new server instance per request; SDK compat path serves 2025 clients

nodes.label: Origin check (DNS-rebinding protection)
nodes.rationale: Foreign Origin -> 403; no Origin (server clients) allowed

nodes.label: Notebook 'for agents' mode access rule (D-04)
nodes.rationale: Checked on every request so switching notebook to private closes access instantly

nodes.label: Grant (static / oauth agent permission)
nodes.rationale: Revoking grant invalidates all its tokens; re-authorization of same client updates the grant

nodes.label: Permissions read / read_write and scopes notes:read, notes:write
Token formats (dsa_, dso_at_, dso_rt_, dso_code_)
nodes.rationale: Only SHA-256 hashes stored; token only in Authorization Bearer header, not URL; refresh token rotation

nodes.label: Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD)
nodes.rationale: HTTPS only, public addresses, <=64 KiB, 5s, 24h cache; public clients only

nodes.label: OAuth consent screen ('Тихая бумага' server HTML page)
nodes.rationale: No JS, no external resources, CSP frame-ancestors none; request state in HMAC-signed form field (15 min)

nodes.label: Errors before redirect_uri validation shown as page (open-redirect protection)
Agents cannot create/rename/delete notebooks (E2E master key)
nodes.rationale: Notebook encrypted with user master key the server does not have

nodes.label: Tool / REST error format (isError, error codes, model-oriented messages)
Handwriting group (one writing 'session', 2.5s pause, 1.5em gap)
nodes.rationale: handwritingId = id of earliest stroke; any stroke id accepted

nodes.label: Escaping and verbatim content (read_note round-trip)
nodes.rationale: read_note -> edit -> read_note must give same text

nodes.label: edit_note operations (insert, replace, delete, move, replace_text; atomic)
Handwriting preservation on edits (replace_text minimal diff, move rewrites anchors)
nodes.rationale: Common prefix/suffix remain same Yjs items so stroke anchors survive; Yjs cannot move items

nodes.label: Agent edit as Yjs update via context.data.applyUpdate (origin kind agent)
Folders and note moves (Folder records in notebook index)
Cross-notebook note move (key rewrap, single transaction)
nodes.rationale: All or nothing; key, history, strokes and attachments unchanged; RLS checks both notebooks

nodes.label: Handwriting PNG rendering (@napi-rs/canvas)
nodes.rationale: Bundled fonts (Inter, Newsreader, Noto Emoji) so image identical on any machine

nodes.label: Handwritten shape preservation (free/scribble/arrow hints)
nodes.rationale: Glyph widths differ between render font and editor font; stroke placed where text averages it

nodes.label: Audit log (AuditEntry)
nodes.rationale: Audit write failure never fails the operation

nodes.label: In-process rate limits (D-25): 120/min per grant, 30/min OAuth per IP
context.store (grants, OAuth clients, codes, tokens, audit)
Notebook/space names duplicated in notebook doc meta
nodes.rationale: Server cannot read encrypted names; clients duplicate name/icon/space (and proposed color) in meta

nodes.label: ds_web cookie session and /connect login page
